extracted.intended_audience: faculty, staff, and students preparing NSF grant proposals (PIs and co-PIs)
extracted.subtask_description: A compliance checklist of common reasons the NSF returns proposals without review, intended to help proposers ensure their submission follows the NSF Grant Proposal Guide and solicitation-specific requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Duplicate or substantially similar proposal
rubrics_metrics.description: Is a duplicate of, or substantially similar to, one already under consideration by NSF from the same PI/co-PI’s
rubrics_metrics.guidance: NSF may return proposals that replicate or substantially overlap other proposals already under consideration from the same team. Ensure distinctness and declare related submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Previously reviewed with no substantial revision
rubrics_metrics.description: Was previously reviewed and has not been substantially revised
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If resubmitting a previously reviewed proposal, make substantive revisions addressing prior reviews; otherwise NSF may return it without review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inappropriate for NSF funding
rubrics_metrics.description: Is inappropriate for funding by the NSF
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals must fall within NSF's mission and the specific program scope. Check the program solicitation to confirm appropriateness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Insufficient lead-time before project start
rubrics_metrics.description: Is submitted with insufficient lead-time before the proposed activity is scheduled to begin
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit early enough to allow review and award processing relative to your proposed start date; insufficient lead-time can trigger return.

rubrics_metrics.name: Not responsive to GPG or solicitation
rubrics_metrics.description: Is not responsive to the NSF Grant Proposal Guide or program announcement/solicitation
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the NSF Grant Proposal Guide (GPG) and the specific program solicitation; non-responsiveness (format, content, or scope) may result in return.

rubrics_metrics.name: Misses announced deadline (late or too early)
rubrics_metrics.description: Does not meet the announced proposal deadline date – either submitting after the deadline or submitting too early
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adhere to the exact proposal deadline window specified by the solicitation; both late and prematurely-timed submissions can be returned.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project Summary: special character conversion errors
rubrics_metrics.description: Contains special characters that have been converted to question marks or other characters while copying and pasting pre-prepared project summary into FastLane text boxes
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When copying into FastLane (or other submission systems), verify that special characters (e.g., Greek letters, symbols) display correctly; conversion errors may cause return.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project Summary length exceeds 4,600 characters
rubrics_metrics.description: Contains more than 4,600 characters
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Project Summaries must not exceed the specified character limit (4,600 characters per this page). Confirm length in submission interface and the current GPG.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project Summary in first person
rubrics_metrics.description: Is in first person
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Project Summaries should adhere to the required voice/style (avoid first person if instructions prohibit it); follow the solicitation/GPG wording conventions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project Summary missing labeled Overview/Intellectual Merit/Broader Impacts
rubrics_metrics.description: Does not contain separately labeled sections for Overview, Intellectual Merit, and Broader Impacts
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Project Summary must include separately labeled sections for Overview, Intellectual Merit, and Broader Impacts; omit or unlabeled sections risk return.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project Description missing 'Broader Impacts' section
rubrics_metrics.description: Does not include a section specifically titled “Broader Impacts of the Proposed Work”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Project Description must include a clearly labeled Broader Impacts section; omission can lead to return without review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project Description missing prior NSF support section
rubrics_metrics.description: Does not include a section describing prior NSF support
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prior NSF support must be reported within the Project Description for each PI/co-PI (subject to page limits); failure to include it may cause return.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prior NSF support: award number and funding amount required
rubrics_metrics.description: NSF award number and Funding amount
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When reporting prior NSF support include the NSF award number and funding amount for each relevant award.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prior NSF support: time period required
rubrics_metrics.description: Time period
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specify the project period (start and end dates) for prior NSF awards reported.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prior NSF support: title required
rubrics_metrics.description: Title
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include the title of the prior NSF-funded project when reporting prior support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prior NSF support: report results with separate Intellectual Merit and Broader Impacts headings
rubrics_metrics.description: Results of the completed work in two separate sections (with headings) for Intellectual Merit and Broader Impacts
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For completed prior NSF-funded work, provide results organized under separate headings for Intellectual Merit and Broader Impacts as part of the prior support report.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prior NSF support: publications/products required
rubrics_metrics.description: Publications / products
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List publications and products resulting from the prior NSF support in the prior support section.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prior NSF support: renewals must explain relation to proposed work
rubrics_metrics.description: If renewal, relation of the completed work to the proposed work
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For renewal proposals, explicitly describe how the completed work relates to the proposed continuation; omission can lead to return.

rubrics_metrics.name: References missing title
rubrics_metrics.description: Does not include reference title
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each reference entry must include the publication title; omit titles from the References section can cause return.

rubrics_metrics.name: References use 'et al.' instead of full author names
rubrics_metrics.description: Contains “et al.”, instead of listing the full names of all authors
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List full names of all authors in references rather than using “et al.” as required by NSF formatting rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: References author order incorrect
rubrics_metrics.description: Does not list author names in the same sequence in which they appear in the publication
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintain the original author order as printed in the publication when listing authors in References.

rubrics_metrics.name: References include non-citation material
rubrics_metrics.description: Includes parenthetical information, footnotes or figures. This References section must contain citations only
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The References section must contain only citation entries; do not include parenthetical commentary, footnotes, or figures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biosketch missing institution locations in Professional Preparation
rubrics_metrics.description: Does not include institution locations in the Professional Preparation section:
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Biosketch Professional Preparation entries must include institution locations; ensure this section follows required format and content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biosketch Products: uses 'et al.' instead of full author list
rubrics_metrics.description: Does not include a complete list of all authors of each publication (i.e., uses “et al.”, instead of listing full names of all authors) in the Products section
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In the Biosketch Products list, provide the complete list of authors for each referenced publication rather than using “et al.”

rubrics_metrics.name: Biosketch Products missing publication titles
rubrics_metrics.description: Does not include publication titles in the Products section
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include publication titles in the Biosketch Products section; omission may violate format requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biosketch exceeds allowable number of publications/synergistic activities
rubrics_metrics.description: Exceeds the allowable number of publications and/or synergistic activities
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Limit publications and synergistic activities to the allowable counts specified by the solicitation/GPG; exceeding limits can cause return.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biosketch combines synergistic activities improperly
rubrics_metrics.description: Combines multiple synergistic activities to appear as one
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List synergistic activities individually as required; combining items to circumvent limits is not acceptable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biosketch includes extra information beyond five required sections
rubrics_metrics.description: Includes additional information other than the five required sections, such as awards and honors
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Biosketches must contain only the five required sections; do not add extra sections like awards/honors unless permitted by solicitation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Current & Pending: project not listed as pending
rubrics_metrics.description: Does not include the project you are applying for currently as “pending” with all appropriate fields completed per the NSF format
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List the current proposal on Current & Pending support as “pending,” completing all required fields according to the NSF format.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget exceeds program maximum
rubrics_metrics.description: Exceeds the maximum funding amount as outlined in program guidelines
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adhere to program-specific maximum funding limits; budgets exceeding stated maxima may be returned.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget unrealistic or not well-justified
rubrics_metrics.description: Amounts must be realistic, reasonable, well-justified or consistent with program guidelines
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide realistic, reasonable, and well-justified budget figures consistent with solicitation guidance; unreasonable requests risk return.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Justification exceeds page limit
rubrics_metrics.description: Exceeds three pages per institution
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Budget Justifications are limited (three pages per institution on this page); exceeding the limit can result in return.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Justification missing detailed pay rates
rubrics_metrics.description: Does not contain detailed rates of pay by individual for senior personnel, postdoctoral associates, and other professionals
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include detailed rates of pay by individual for senior personnel, postdocs, and other professionals in the Budget Justification as required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contains cost share (when prohibited)
rubrics_metrics.description: Contains cost share
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cost sharing is prohibited by NSF unless explicitly required by the solicitation. Do not include cost share unless the program solicitation requires it.

rubrics_metrics.name: Letters of Commitment exceed scope (include evaluative/supportive statements)
rubrics_metrics.description: Submits Letters of Commitment that go beyond just confirming collaborations
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Letters of Commitment may only confirm the nature of a collaboration; avoid additional remarks about PI/co-PI accomplishments or planned undertakings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Letters of Commitment must only confirm collaboration (no added praise)
rubrics_metrics.description:
Letter of Commitment can only confirm a collaboration and not general support
Additional remarks about PI/co-PI’s past accomplishments or planned undertakings may not be included
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Limit Letters of Commitment strictly to confirmation of collaboration; remove evaluative language or endorsements.

rubrics_metrics.name: General Letters of Support from unrelated individuals
rubrics_metrics.description: Contains general Letters of Support from individuals not mentioned in the proposal
rubrics_metrics.guidance: General Letters of Support are not accepted by NSF unless specifically requested in a program solicitation; include only what is permitted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Letters of Support prohibited unless solicitation allows
rubrics_metrics.description: Letters of support are not accepted by NSF, unless specifically requested in a program solicitation
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the program solicitation: include Letters of Support only when explicitly allowed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Improper font size or margins
rubrics_metrics.description: Uses small font size and margins.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adhere to the font size and margin requirements in the NSF Grant Proposal Guide; inappropriate font/margin manipulation to fit content may cause return.
